headline: Türkiye's 9-Month Pistachio Exports Reach 80.9 Million Dollars
summary: Türkiye's pistachio exports reached $80.9 million over nine months. The producers' union expects exports to rise further in the last quarter as the new season's crop enters the market.
why: Pistachios are an agricultural export commodity, and Turkey is a major global supplier, so volumes and prices affect food trade flows.
